verdicts.merged_construct: Le Chatelier RLHF: Equilibrium-Restoring KL Control under Reward Stress
verdicts.bare_mechanism: A full PID controller on the policy-reference KL in KL-penalized PPO, whose distinctive piece is a derivative/rate term: the KL penalty coefficient and clip range respond to the positive rate-of-change of KL (max(dKL/dstep,0)) to anticipatorily brake reward over-optimization transients, on top of the standard PI adaptive-KL set-point regulation.
active_area_candidates: Adaptive-KL controllers in RLHF (PI control of KL coefficient)
Reward over-optimization / over-optimization-control in RLHF
PID-on-KL with predictive/derivative (reward-velocity) terms
searches_run: PID control KL penalty RLHF reward over-optimization adaptive KL controller derivative term 2025 2026
verdicts.which_active_variant_of: PID-on-KL adaptive control in RLHF with a derivative term on KL/reward rate. SAFE (arxiv 2602.04651, Feb 2026) is an entropy-aware predictive controller with PID-driven adaptive KL thresholding that 'dynamically adjusts divergence tolerance based on reward velocity' — reward velocity is exactly M005's dKL/dstep anticipatory term. epsilon-DPO (Oct 2025) adapts the KL coefficient from observed monotonicity. M005 = the same derivative/predictive-on-KL control, re-metaphored as Le Chatelier.
verdicts.reasoning: This is the M032-style trap. M005 itself isolates its only-novel ingredient as the derivative/rate term on KL ('anticipatory braking of over-optimization'), conceding the PI part is the known adaptive-KL controller. But search shows that exact derivative/predictive-on-KL-rate mechanism is already an active method: SAFE (Feb 2026) does PID-driven adaptive KL thresholding keyed to reward velocity (= dKL/dstep) for the same over-optimization-control purpose. So even the 'genuinely new' piece is a published variant of the active over-optimization-control / adaptive-KL area. Nominal novelty (Le Chatelier framing) over a structurally-present mechanism does not qualify.

CMA-ES LRA (arXiv 2401.15876) is a closed loop holding an update SNR statistic at a target set-point by raising/lowering the LR — mechanically M012's fast baroreflex loop on p=||g||^2/||v||. Two-timescale LR with a slow, regime-resetting meta-set-point is modeled by ALFA (2011.00209) and explicit fast-adapter/slow-controller architectures ('reset when environmental statistics change; meta-learned higher-order parameters').

verdicts.which_active_variant_of: Variant of adaptive-per-expert-capacity MoE + loss-free-balancing-with-overflow-reroute. MoSE (arXiv 2602.06154) gives variable per-expert width ('conditional computation over how much of each expert is utilized') with 'dynamic gating tunes expert capacity to token load'; loss-free bias balancing (2408.15664) replaces the aux loss; Token Reroute / Capacity-Aware Inference (2503.05066) and LASER redistribute overflow to underutilized/least-loaded experts. All three are active 2024-2026 areas with near-exact analogs (MoSE slimmable width keyed to load; DeepSeek loss-free bias; Token Reroute down the utilization gradient). The only nominal addition is the Frank-Starling 'decompensation' limb where capacity DROPS past a plateau, but the construct itself states this risks self-starvation and must be 'effectively disabled', so it introduces no beneficial unmodeled quantity — it is a counterproductive curve shape, not a structural regime with no current analog. verdicts.bare_mechanism: Speculative decoding where exact single-shot accept/reject is replaced by graded acceptance: accumulate target confidence on each draft token from cheap early-exit/intermediate-layer signals, accept once a threshold is crossed (and let a strongly-accepted token lower its successors' thresholds), and run full deep verification only from the estimated layer-depth at which draft and target first diverge, skipping shallow layers that already agree.

verdicts.which_active_variant_of: Variant of early-exit self-speculative decoding + partial/depth-localized verification. SpecPV (arXiv 2512.02337) is 'self-speculative decoding via partial verification'; EESD (2406.03853) re-purposes the first-E layers and partially reuses computation between draft and verification; HiSpec (2510.01336) does hierarchical/early-exit verification; intermediate-model verification that 'discards inaccurate tokens early' on confidence is exactly M017's graded acceptance on early-exit signals.
verdicts.reasoning: De-metaphored, the complement/seismology construct is graded, early-exit-confidence acceptance plus verify-deep-only-from-the-divergence-depth — both squarely in active early-exit self-speculative + partial-verification work (SpecPV, EESD, HiSpec). The construct itself admits approximate acceptance forfeits the exact-distribution guarantee, i.e. it is just lossy/approximate self-speculative decoding, an active area. The opsonin 'cascade gain' (accepted token lowers successors' thresholds) is a minor neighbor-coupling heuristic, not an unmodeled quantity with no analog. NOT_NICHE.

verdicts.merged_construct: Herd-Immunity Dropout with Seafloor-Spreading Capacity Accretion
verdicts.bare_mechanism: Two bolted-together mechanisms: (a) set dropout per layer adaptively from a measured feature-dependency proxy estimated by perturbation probes (how many downstream units are corrupted when a unit is perturbed), dropping more where dependency/sensitivity is high; and (b) an age-structured growing schedule that accretes new plastic units at a layer and freezes them as they age, for continual/lifelong learning.
active_area_candidates: Adaptive / sensitivity- and information-driven per-unit/per-layer dropout (Rate-In, concrete/variational dropout)
Neurogenesis / progressive network growth with freezing for continual learning (DSD-SNN, Neuroplastic Expansion, 'when/where/how to add neurons to ANNs')

progressive network growth freeze old neurons add new units age-structured continual learning neurogenesis 2024 2025
verdicts.which_active_variant_of: Rate-In (arXiv 2412.07169, CVPR 2025) adapts dropout per layer and per instance from a measured information-loss-to-downstream-feature-maps signal — exactly M018's perturbation-measured dependency proxy. The growth half is neurogenesis/progressive-growth continual learning (DSD-SNN dynamically grows+prunes neurons; Neuroplastic Expansion 2410.07994 regenerates and consolidates neurons; survey 2202.08539 on adding neurons to ANNs).
verdicts.reasoning: De-metaphored (herd immunity R0, seafloor spreading), the two parts are (a) sensitivity-/dependency-driven adaptive dropout and (b) age-structured grow-and-freeze continual learning — both confirmed-active areas. Rate-In already measures downstream information loss per unit/layer to set the rate, so the 'downstream-units-that-collapse' R0 quantity has a direct current analog; the 1-1/R0 herd-immunity formula is just a heuristic mapping from that measured sensitivity to a rate. The construct itself frames the branching-process guarantee as unverified and notes the two halves are 'bolted together,' so even the union is two separate active-area variants, not a structurally novel regime.

ElaLoRA (arXiv 2504.00254) simultaneously prunes and expands rank, reallocating a budget toward critical layers; DaRA reallocates ranks after a coarse warm-up by discarding directions from unimportant modules and assigning more to important ones; FlexLoRA (2601.22905) explicitly schedules 'aggressive rank reallocation early, gradual stabilization toward convergence' — i.e. the same phase/aggressiveness control M020 claims.
verdicts.reasoning: De-metaphored (wound-healing phases, glacier accumulation/ablation), this is staged dynamic-rank LoRA with a fixed total rank budget that flows between layers by importance — the defining AdaLoRA paradigm. Search shows the exact distinctive elements (early-aggressive-then-stabilize phasing in FlexLoRA, warm-up-then-reallocate in DaRA, prune+expand under a budget in ElaLoRA) already exist. No unmodeled quantity.

verdicts.merged_construct: Gate-Control Pain Inhibition for Gradient Routing with River-Delta Distributary Sharding
verdicts.bare_mechanism: On a shared backbone with task-conditioned (reasoning vs tool-use) gradient streams routed partly to disjoint adapters, combine the two shared-path gradients with a soft magnitude-dependent gate g=sigma(k(|g_R|-|g_T|)+d) so the larger-norm stream dominates the shared weights (plus a top-down bias and optional PCGrad projection for direction conflict), and reroute shared updates into the least-used rank subspace when the active subspace saturates, to preserve plasticity.

Search confirms magnitude-based and adaptive-arbitration gradient-conflict methods are an active, named family (the literature explicitly notes 'prior works only alter gradient magnitudes'), and subspace partitioning/rerouting for plasticity is an active continual-learning area. verdicts.which_active_variant_of: Variant of decay-based budgeted KV retention + multi-tier mixed-precision KV. TRIM-KV (arXiv 2512.03324) predicts a per-token retention score that 'decays exponentially over time' with rate beta and evicts below budget — exactly M022's first-order half-life washout with attention re-dosing; G-KV adds a 'memory decay rate alpha'; mixed-precision KV (2402.18096, KVmix) and progressive-precision eviction (RaaS/LazyEviction/R-KV 'progressively reduce token precision during decoding') supply the fp16->lowbit->summary tiers.
verdicts.reasoning: De-metaphored, the PK compartment model is just attention-refreshed exponential decay of a token importance score plus multi-tier precision demotion under a memory budget. TRIM-KV/G-KV already model the exponential half-life decay-and-evict, and progressive-precision eviction methods already do continuous fp16->lowbit fidelity reduction; mixed-precision KV covers the tiers. verdicts.which_active_variant_of: Sign-statistic LR adaptation crossed with PID-on-LR control. ActiveLR adapts the LR per-epoch on whether the gradient changes sign (arxiv 2301.10133 / related); delta-bar-delta and RPROP adapt step size on sign agreement/disagreement; PIDAO (Nature Communications 2024) and Incremental-PID-LR (IEEE 2022) close an explicit PI/PID loop on the scalar LR. M064 = these with the controlled variable chosen as sign-flip RATE-to-a-set-point rather than instantaneous sign.
verdicts.reasoning: Stripped of the PLL/governor metaphor, M064 is a PI controller on the scalar LR driven by a gradient-sign statistic. Both ingredients are active: search confirms sign-change-driven LR adaptation (ActiveLR, RPROP, delta-bar-delta, still studied in 2024) and explicit PID/PI-on-LR controllers (PIDAO 2024, Incremental-PID-LR, SPI-Optimizer). Targeting the sign-flip RATE to a set-point instead of the instantaneous sign is a parameter/observable choice within these families, not an unmodeled quantity. The construct itself concedes it merely 'generalizes' RPROP/delta-bar-delta into a PI loop, which is the definition of a method-variant.
